comment: Rights policy for SAM Stream. trustedYouTubeChannels: channel id -> distributor name, ONLY for channels you have verified are the official rights holder/distributor (e.g. via the distributor's website linking the channel, or a written agreement). blockedSources: source ids (e.g. 'ia:identifier', 'yt:videoId') removed after a rights report. The app fetches the latest copy of this file from the repository at startup, so edits here take effect without an app update.
